discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.intro: Each option in the discord_voice_bridge.json file:
discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.token: - token: Discord bot token (required; create one at discord.com/developers/applications)
discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.voice: - voiceChannelId: ID of the Discord voice channel the bridge joins (server channel, not the bot's own)
discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.group: - groupName: name of the Simple Voice Chat group created on the server
- groupType: NORMAL or ISOLATED (SVC group type; Discord audio is sent to the group members either way)
- groupPassword: password to join the group; empty = no password (public group)
discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.legac: - legacyUserIds: Discord user IDs of senders still on unencrypted (legacy) voice (music bots, old clients); their audio is passed through so they can be heard. Leave empty if nobody needs it
discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.enabl: - enabled: turn the bridge on/off without restarting the server
discord_voice_bridge.config_readme.reloa: After editing, use /dvc config reload (or restart the server).
